title: KOG Coach Debrief
summary: KOG opened 2026–27 with a 74–67 win over Skuru. The scorebook points to a shared scoring load, composure across the four quarters, and a disciplined defensive effort.
source: Official match protocol: Kungsholmen OG 74–67 Skuru Basket, 19 September 2026.

highlights.title: Shared scoring load
highlights.note: Max Landgren (16) and Hawsoon Jobe (15) led the way, while six other scorers added 43 points. KOG did not need one player to carry the offense.

highlights.title: Closed the game
highlights.note: KOG led just 38–37 at half, then kept winning the margins to finish seven points ahead.

highlights.title: Multiple ways to score
highlights.stat: 30 made field goals · 7 made threes · 7 made free throws
highlights.note: Seven threes — four from Hawsoon — gave KOG a perimeter route alongside 23 made two-pointers.

highlights.title: Foul discipline
highlights.note: KOG committed five fewer team fouls in the protocol, an important edge in a close game.

takeaways: Keep trusting the extra pass and the whole rotation: eight different players found points.
Use the same calm finish next game: win the last quarter, protect the lead, and make the opponent chase.
